{{Short description|Philosopher at the University of Manchester}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2022}}
'''David Liggins''' is a philosopher at the [[University of Manchester]] with research interests in [[metaphysics]] and [[philosophy of mathematics]].

== Education and career ==
Liggins received his PhD in 2005 from the [[University of Sheffield]]. He then spent a year at [[University of Cambridge]]'s faculty of philosophy before becoming a lecturer at the [[University of Manchester]] in 2006.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Researchers: Dr David Liggins |url=https://www.research.manchester.ac.uk/portal/en/researchers/null(300f0ac7-b759-4bbb-a8f9-26cb191ae226).html |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=The University of Manchester |language=en}}</ref> In 2016, he was appointed joint editor of [[Analysis (journal)|''Analysis'']] with Chris Daly.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Weinberg |first=Justin |date=2016-08-10 |title=Analysis (the Philosophy Journal) to Broaden Scope |url=https://dailynous.com/2016/08/10/analysis-philosophy-journal-broaden-scope/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Daily Nous |language=en-US}}</ref> He served as the sole editor of the journal from 2017 to 2021 when it was announced that he would be joint editor alongside Stacie Friend and Lee Walters.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Leiter |first=Brian |date=2021-02-26 |title=New editors of the journal "Analysis" announced |url=https://leiterreports.typepad.com/blog/2021/02/new-editors-of-the-journal-analysis-announced.html |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Leiter Reports}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Weinberg |first=Justin |date=2021-03-01 |title=New Editors at "Analysis" |url=https://dailynous.com/2021/03/01/new-editors-at-analysis/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Daily Nous |language=en-US}}</ref>
